run_get_contextual_embeddings: run the get_contextual_embeddings script to extract layer-wise embeddings from sentences using a named language model
build_model_by_name: build a language model by name using build_model_by_name from lama.modules with parsed args
get_contextual_embeddings_method: get contextual embeddings, sentence lengths, and tokenized text from a model for a list of sentences
try_cuda: try to move the language model to GPU using the try_cuda method on the model instance
parse_general_args: parse command-line arguments using options.get_general_parser and options.parse_args to configure model names and cuda
